text: INC-1: tenant scope bypass in src/core/store.mjs (quoted/qualified identifiers, tenant_id updates, raw handle on tctx.db)
INC-1 fixed: guardScoped() refuses quoted/qualified tenant tables and tenant_id assignment; tctx.db limited to scoped facade; regression test added

INCIDENT SEC2-001 high src/modules/intake/routes.js:4 intake routes admit role agent (not in openapi x-roles) and assertAccess (service.js:51-53) only restricts claimants, so any agent token reads and writes every intake session (decrypted PII answers) in the tenant. Verified. Fix: drop agent from ROLES or scope sessions to startedBy. Test: tests/security/sec2-rbac-pii.test.mjs

INCIDENT SEC2-002 high src/modules/coverage/service.mjs:59 cacheSnapshot stores JSON.stringify(snapshot) in policy_snapshots.doc, so insured and driver names, addresses and garaging postcodes (x-pii) are plaintext at rest. Verified by DB dump. Fix: encrypt PII fields (mock-pas already splits them) or cache only the PII-free part

INCIDENT SEC2-003 high src/modules/integrations/adapters/fake-core.mjs:80 GET /integrations/fake-core/claims (not in openapi, always mounted) returns decrypted unmasked claim payloads to integration and supervisor; integration is redacted on the claims API so this bypasses redaction. Verified. Fix: gate behind devMode or remove, mask payload

INCIDENT SEC2-004 high src/modules/claims/routes.mjs:36 GET /claims/{id} admits claimant and returns the whole claim doc incl. triage.fraudScore, flags (siu) and routing.adjusterId (service.mjs:494-503); any claimant in the tenant can read any claim (R5 still open). Verified. Fix: claimant projection allowlist plus claimIds ownership check

INCIDENT SEC2-005 high src/modules/evidence/parse.mjs:85 PDF text extraction: lazy BT/ET and stream regexes are O(n^2) (700 KB file = 21 s) and zlib.inflateSync at :104 has no output cap (300 KB bomb = 6.7 s, ~1 GB RSS). Runs synchronously on upload; one claimant request stalls all tenants. Verified. Fix: linear scanner, maxOutputLength, worker thread

INCIDENT SEC2-006 high src/modules/evidence/routes.mjs:41 contentBase64 validity regex backtracks quadratically (30k spaces + '!' = 1.4 s, 80k = 10 s, 15 MB body = hours), reachable with a claimant token. Verified. Fix: length-bound and Buffer round-trip check instead of the regex

INCIDENT SEC2-007 high src/modules/integrations/webhooks/worker.mjs:86 SSRF via DNS rebinding: checkResolvedHost resolves once (url-guard.mjs:104 admits the race) then global fetch resolves again; same pattern in adapters/index.mjs:128 for the claimsPort target. A tenant admin with attacker DNS can POST signed bodies to internal addresses. Fix: pin the validated IP via an undici dispatcher/lookup or an egress proxy

Orchestrator error: ran git stash --include-untracked while wave 1b agents (S5-AI-03, S5-AI-06, S5-WFL-03) were writing; their in-flight files vanished for ~1 min and the pop conflicted on S5-AI-06.json. Restored (worktree kept as newer superset, ticket JSON resolved to newer side), no work lost. Rule: never stash or checkout while any workflow runs; commit by path only.

(same expression)
Revoked the s5-diag-1h IAP grant early; policy back to user:teachjustin@gmail.com only (verified with get-iam-policy)

Sponsor sees 'Service unavailable' on the deployed claimant app. Causes: (1) isDevMode trusts only localhost, so dev login is refused on run.app and no API call is made; (2) IAP intercepts Authorization: Bearer. Also S5-WFL-01's token-name holder match breaks the claimant vehicle picker (tests/ui). Fix tickets S5-EXP-01, S5-WFL-04; redeploy after.
